architecture_outline: Use Vue 3 Single-File Components with clear boundaries.
Separate UI, reusable reactive logic, API requests, and shared state when warranted.
Keep authoritative validation, prices, inventory, authentication, and payment verification on a backend.
reference_approach: For Task Tracker, implement Add and delete tasks, Filter by all, active, and completed, Edit task titles without losing focus, Show useful empty states and task counts. Follow milestone order, keep state in one source of truth, and use the official documentation linked in the course.
review_checklist: Filter by all, active, and completed
Edit task titles without losing focus
Show useful empty states and task counts
A normal and a failure/boundary case have repeatable evidence.
The build, runtime assumptions, and any untested paths are documented.
